pr.title: feat(QPBT/Observables): prove ideal point EPR consistency
pr.body:
### Motivation
The proof of `lem:qld-comm-cons` uses perfect consistency of ancillary Pauli
point projectors on the two halves of an EPR pair. Issue #267 isolates this
ingredient. See `references/qpbt-paper/14_analysis_of_the_pauli_basis_test.tex`,
`eq:def-psihat`, `eq:qld-point-obs-def`, and the proof at line 489.

### Description
Add `Observables/IdealPointConsistency.lean` and its QPBT aggregate import.
The existing transpose and multiplication identities establish orthogonality
of distinct point fibers and transport a point projector between EPR halves.
Unequal joint outcomes annihilate the EPR vector and have zero joint weight;
the off-diagonal mass and the `consistencyDefect` for any point distribution
vanish. The shared off-diagonal theorem is also used by all three extraction
consistency identities in `Extraction/NonencodingSupport.lean`, replacing its
duplicate private proof.

The unit diagonal overlap already exists as
`ProjectiveSetting.sum_tauPointProj_pair_stateQForm_eprState` in
`Observables/ExpandedPlacement.lean`; no second proof is added. The
point-fiber positivity and completeness lemmas remain private in
`ExpandedDefs.lean`, where their callers reside. No paper-labelled approximate
theorem, source statement, or blueprint completion claim changes. This PR
establishes only perfect ancillary EPR consistency, not approximate consistency
or commutation for the original strategy.

Statement integrity: the paper fixes a characteristic-two finite field, a
Pauli basis, a point, its ideal point projectors, and the EPR pair. Lean uses
`AdmissibleParams`, `PauliKind`, `tauPointProj`, and `eprState`; the conclusions
are zero unequal-outcome vector/joint mass and zero ancillary consistency
defect. Verdict: faithful domain data, no added strategy or correlation
assumptions; the full `lem:qld-comm-cons` is not claimed.

### Testing
- Direct `lake env lean` checks of `ExpandedDefs.lean`,
  `IdealPointConsistency.lean`, and `NonencodingSupport.lean`: passed.
- Targeted `lake build MIPStarRE.QPBT.Extraction.NonencodingSupport`: passed.
- Narrow proof-hole/bypass scan and `git diff --check`: passed.
- Ordinary commit hooks: passed (see separate receipt).
- No full build, CI, blueprint render, publication, or author review for this
  repaired head. The earlier head `68151428cd78769561c0d51a3ac92f7666e5e7a7`
  had successful exact-head CI; that status does not cover this commit.

---
Closes #267

# Review - PR 271 @ 5840bcbb342f3cf646f1a2c38c0565ea464245b6

Independent review by a Claude Opus helper (owner-authorized 2026-09-17); no author, fixer or prior reviewer context reused. ## Findings

- none

## Review

**Scope.** Main-relative diff at this head is `MIPStarRE/QPBT.lean` (+1 aggregate import), `MIPStarRE/QPBT/Extraction/NonencodingSupport.lean` (+1/-13) and the new `MIPStarRE/QPBT/Observables/IdealPointConsistency.lean` (+126). I compared the PR's own patch at the fourth-reviewed head (`git diff $(git merge-base github/main 68151428) 68151428`) with its own patch at this head, patch-against-patch: the only differences are (a) the `ExpandedDefs.lean` hunk disappearing entirely and (b) the `NonencodingSupport.lean` hunk appearing. `IdealPointConsistency.lean` is byte-identical between the two heads (same blob `92d6a0a7`), and no other file, hunk or line differs. The two merge commits therefore carry main only.

**F1 (duplicate off-diagonal identity) resolved.** The private `ProjectiveSetting.tauPoint_offDiagonal_eq_zero` that formerly sat at `NonencodingSupport.lean:83` is deleted - `git grep tauPoint_offDiagonal_eq_zero` at this head returns nothing - and all three extraction consumers (`NonencodingSupport.lean:99,121,143`, inside `point_encodingPauli_consistency_eq`, `encodingPauli_point_consistency_eq` and `expanded_point_consistency_eq`) now pass the single public `tauPointProj_epr_offDiagonal_eq_zero` (`IdealPointConsistency.lean:91`). The two statements were literally the same proposition (same namespace, same binders, same `∑ a, ∑ b, if a = b then 0 else stateQForm (eprState (PauliRegister P)) (heteroKron (tauPointProj W u a) (tauPointProj W u b)) = 0`), so the three call sites need no adaptation and none was made; only the new `import MIPStarRE.QPBT.Observables.IdealPointConsistency` line was added. This is the collapse-onto-one-declaration outcome F1 asked for, with the surviving declaration the lower, shared, public one and its proof and consumers preserved. The added import is not a layering inversion: `Extraction/` modules already import `QPBT.Test.MagicSquareTheorems.*` on main (`Extraction/EPRState.lean`, `Observables.lean`, `OverlapTransfer.lean`, `PauliComparison.lean`), and `Observables/ExpandedPlacement.lean` already imports the same `PerfectStrategy.Observables` that the new module does.

**F2 (unmotivated public surface) resolved.** `ExpandedDefs.lean` at this head is byte-identical to `github/main` (`git diff` between the two blobs is empty); `tauPointProj_nonneg` (`:402`) and `sum_tauPointProj_eq_one` (`:411`) are `private` again, and their only uses remain in-file (`:432,433,464,484,516`). No new public caller was introduced to justify exposure, and the PR description now states the opposite of the old claim ("The point-fiber positivity and completeness lemmas remain private in `ExpandedDefs.lean`, where their callers reside") and correctly describes the shared off-diagonal theorem as replacing a duplicate private proof.

**Integrity and elaboration.** No `sorry`, `admit`, `axiom` or `native_decide` occurs on any added line of the main-relative diff. No theorem statement or definition changed in the repair: the deleted declaration was a duplicate, not a weakening, and the surviving statement is unchanged from the one the fourth round found faithful to item 1 of `lem:qld-comm-cons` (`references/qpbt-paper/14_analysis_of_the_pauli_basis_test.tex:463`, proof at line 489). In the PR worktree at HEAD `5840bcbb` (equal to the published head), `lake env lean MIPStarRE/QPBT/Observables/IdealPointConsistency.lean` and `lake env lean MIPStarRE/QPBT/Extraction/NonencodingSupport.lean` each produced no diagnostics. Exact-head status `gh api .../commits/5840bcbb.../status` is `success` with all nine contexts green, including `local-ci/build`, `local-ci/proof-debt`, `local-ci/proof-evasion` and `local-ci/statement-origin`.

**Non-blocking observation, not a finding.** The PR body's Testing section still says "No full build, CI, blueprint render, publication ... for this repaired head" and points at `68151428` for CI. That sentence is now stale rather than an over-claim - exact-head CI for `5840bcbb` is green - so it understates, and it does not need to change before merge.

**Not checked (out of this bounded scope).** I did not re-open the fourth round's faithfulness analysis of the five identities in `IdealPointConsistency.lean` (that file is unchanged and was reviewed at `68151428`), did not run a full `lake build` or the rooted axiom audit myself, and did not re-derive the unchanged main lemmas `epr_action_eq_of_transpose`, `tauPointProj_transpose` and `tauPointProj_mul_tauPointProj`. Prose lane is n/a: the diff touches no blueprint TeX, docs, paper-gap note or audit.

VERDICT: APPROVED (code=APPROVED, prose=n/a)

- [x] F1 (changes) `MIPStarRE/QPBT/Observables/IdealPointConsistency.lean:47` - Resolved: the duplicate `pauliProj_mul` proof and its supporting `star_pauliVec` are gone; `tauPointProj_mul_eq_zero_of_ne` now specializes the existing `tauPointProj_mul_tauPointProj` using `if_neg hab`, exactly as requested in review 5185413075.

The new declaration has no callers, and the existing result is already used by `PointConsistency.lean:280,414`. Fix: remove the redundant new diagonal proof; retain/reuse the existing public result and update the PR description's claim of a newly proved diagonal identity.

## Review
The source assertion is the perfect consistency of the ancillary Pauli projections in the proof of `lem:qld-comm-cons`, `references/qpbt-paper/14_analysis_of_the_pauli_basis_test.tex:489`, with the projectors defined in `eq:qld-point-obs-def` (lines 383-411) and the ancillary EPR pair defined in `eq:def-psihat` (lines 367-369). The Pauli eigenprojectors are specified in `references/qpbt-paper/04_preliminaries.tex:1101-1161`. The existing blueprint describes the same ancillary claim at `blueprint/src/chapter/ch14_qpbt_observables.tex:1552-1559`; the PR adds no blueprint tags and makes no claim to prove the full approximate self-consistency or approximate commutation of `lem:qld-comm-cons`.

Statement integrity: the paper assumes an admissible characteristic-two field, either Pauli basis, a point, the corresponding coarse-grained Pauli projectors, and two halves of their maximally entangled register; it concludes perfect agreement for the ancillary outcomes. The Lean auxiliaries quantify over `P : AdmissibleParams`, `W : PauliKind`, `u : Fin P.m -> PauliScalar P` (and an arbitrary question distribution in the last theorem), act with the actual `tauPointProj` on `eprState (PauliRegister P)`, and conclude that unequal joint outcomes annihilate the vector/have zero joint mass, that the off-diagonal total is zero, and that the consistency defect vanishes. Verdict: faithful ancillary identities with domain data only; no extra strategy, correlation, symmetry, or proof-obligation hypotheses, and no weakened paper conclusion advertised as the full lemma.

The proof path is valid on inspection: `pauliProj_transpose` and `tauPointProj_transpose` give EPR transport; the existing `pauliProj_mul_pauliProj` and `tauPointProj_mul_tauPointProj` give disjoint-fibre orthogonality; `heteroKron_mul` moves both operators to one side; the normalized `eprState` and `sum_tauPointProj_eq_one` give total mass one; the final theorem averages a pointwise zero off-diagonal defect. The existing private off-diagonal theorem in `Extraction/NonencodingSupport.lean:83` establishes a related sum only in a later module; the new vector-level result and the earlier public theorem remain useful. F2 is specifically the *unused second public proof of diagonal mass one*, not a renewed objection to F1.
